tr: Wa qaddim umūrī Yā Muqaddimu haybatan
en: Expedite my affair, O Expeditor, prestigiously – Delay our enemies O Delayer, with obstacles

ar: بِغَيْرِ انْتِهَاءٍ أَنْتَ فِي الْكُلِّ حَسْبُنَا
tr: Wa Yā Awwalu min ghayri bad’in wa ākhirun
en: O Eternal, without beginning, Everlasting – Without end, You suffice us in

tr: Wa Yā Ẓāhiran fī kulli shay’in shu’ūnuhū
Wa Yā Bātinan bi ‘l-ghaybi lā zilta muḥsinā
en: O Manifest in the affairs of everything – O Hidden unseen, You never cease being good to us
blocks.review: شُءُوْنُهٗ: single wāw with the hamza floating above the shīn–wāw join, encoded with standalone ء as on p115; the mark on the final hāʾ is small and could be a sukūn rather than an inverted ḍamma.

tr: Wa yā wāliyan lasnā li ghayrika nantamī
Fa bi ‘n-naṣri Yā Muta`āliyan kun mu`izzanā
en: O Governor, we associate ourselves with no other – So with help, O Most High, be our fortifier

ar: وَيَا بَرُّ يَا تَوَّابُ جُدْ لِيْ بِتَوْبَةٍ
tr: Wa Yā Barru Yā Tawwābu jud lī bi tawbatin
en: O Beneficent, O Accepter of Repentance, bless me with Repentance Sincere, eradicate thereby our enormities
